# `credentials` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/credentials.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Module id | `credentials` |
| Name | Credentials |
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Ships from | `@endora-commerce/mod-credentials` |
| Licence | `MIT` |

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `credentials.enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.
